answer: Standing is a pulse that only counts when it is felt by hand: each epoch’s work must be done by hand — the identity must do its work itself, feeling the pulse of its own work, never automating it or delegating it to a fake — a raven only counts when it is flown by hand, and a ripple only counts when it is made by hand. A farm of a thousand fakes feels no pulse by hand, automating everything and never touching their own work, so their pulse never counts, and one epoch of automating everything adds nothing.
